task.title: Report a Phishing Email
task.shortdesc: Report a suspicious phishing email to campus OIT on Gmail.

taskbody.context: Report any suspicious email using Gmail on a computer. Your report goes straight to OIT's Cybersecurity Operations team, which helps protect you and the rest of the university.

step.cmd: On a computer, open the suspicious email.
Select More (three vertical dots) at the top right of the message.
Select Report Phishing Button to confirm.
step.stepresult: The email is reported and moved to your Spam folder.

taskbody.postreq: For help, contact the NC State Help Desk through the IT Service Portal or call 919.515.HELP (4357).
